label: Reporting period length
definition_plain: How many months the report covers. Almost always 12.

label: Annualisation factor
definition_plain: What to multiply a yearly total by to make a non-12-month year comparable with a normal year.

label: Turnover
definition_plain: Revenue from operations in rupees, after the scale corrections.

label: Turnover (Rs crore)
definition_plain: The same turnover in rupees crore; the denominator of every intensity.

label: Total workforce
definition_plain: Everyone working for the company: employees and workers, permanent and other than permanent.

label: Women in the workforce
definition_plain: The number of women among employees and workers.

label: Women in workforce (%)
definition_plain: Out of every 100 people working for the company, how many are women.

label: Women share of gross wages (%)
definition_plain: Out of every 100 rupees of wages the company pays, how many go to women.

label: Pay equity gap (pp)
definition_plain: Women's share of wages minus women's share of the workforce. Negative means women get a smaller slice of the pay than of the headcount.

label: Women on the board (%)
definition_plain: The share of board directors who are women.

label: Attrition, women (%)
definition_plain: The share of permanent female employees who left during the year.

label: Attrition, men (%)
definition_plain: The share of permanent male employees who left during the year.

label: Attrition gap (pp)
definition_plain: How much faster women leave than men. Positive means women leave more often.

label: Scope 1 emissions
definition_plain: Greenhouse gases from sources the company owns or controls (fuel burnt, process emissions).

label: Scope 2 emissions
definition_plain: Greenhouse gases from the electricity, heat and steam the company buys.

label: Scope 1+2 emissions
definition_plain: The company's own emissions plus those of the energy it buys.

label: Scope 3 emissions
definition_plain: Emissions in the value chain (suppliers, product use). Voluntary, so often missing.

label: GHG intensity (Scope 1+2 per Rs crore)
definition_plain: Tonnes of greenhouse gas for every Rs 1 crore of revenue. Lets a big and a small company be compared.

label: GHG intensity as filed
formula_text: filed value read as per rupee, x 1e7
definition_plain: The intensity the company itself reported. A cross-check only: companies use different denominators.

label: GHG intensity: filed / computed
definition_plain: How far the company's own intensity is from ours. 1 means it agrees; 10,000,000 means it divided by crore instead of rupees.

label: Total energy
definition_plain: All the energy the company used in the year.

label: Renewable energy
definition_plain: The part of that energy that came from renewable sources.

label: Renewable share of energy (%)
definition_plain: Out of all the energy used, the percentage from solar, wind, hydro and other renewables.

label: Energy intensity (GJ per Rs crore)
definition_plain: Energy used for every Rs 1 crore of revenue.

label: Energy intensity as filed
formula_text: filed value read as per rupee, x 1e7
definition_plain: The energy intensity the company itself reported. A cross-check only.

label: Energy intensity: filed / computed
definition_plain: How far the company's own energy intensity is from ours.

label: Water withdrawal
definition_plain: All the water the company took from any source.

label: Water consumption
definition_plain: Water taken and not returned (withdrawal minus discharge).

label: Water intensity (kl per Rs crore)
definition_plain: Water consumed for every Rs 1 crore of revenue.

label: Water intensity as filed
formula_text: filed value read as per rupee, x 1e7
definition_plain: The water intensity the company itself reported. A cross-check only.

label: Water intensity: filed / computed
definition_plain: How far the company's own water intensity is from ours.

label: Waste generated
definition_plain: All the waste the company produced.

label: Waste recovered
definition_plain: Waste recycled, re-used or otherwise recovered.

label: Waste disposed
definition_plain: Waste burnt, landfilled or otherwise disposed of.

label: Waste recovery rate (%)
definition_plain: Out of all the waste produced, the percentage recovered instead of dumped. Above 100 means old stock was recovered too.

label: Waste intensity (t per Rs crore)
definition_plain: Tonnes of waste for every Rs 1 crore of revenue.

label: Waste balance gap (%)
definition_plain: A consistency check: the share of waste that is neither recovered nor disposed in the filing. Far from 0 means the figures do not add up.

label: LTIFR, employees
definition_plain: Injuries that cost working time, per one million hours worked by employees.

label: LTIFR, workers
definition_plain: Injuries that cost working time, per one million hours worked by workers.

label: Recordable injuries
definition_plain: All work injuries that had to be recorded, employees and workers together.

label: Fatalities
definition_plain: Work-related deaths, employees and workers together.

label: Fatalities per 10,000 workforce
definition_plain: Work-related deaths for every 10,000 people working for the company.

label: POSH complaints (% of female staff)
definition_plain: Sexual-harassment complaints as a share of female staff. Not ranked: a higher figure can mean more incidents or more trust in the reporting channel.

label: POSH complaints upheld
definition_plain: How many of those complaints were upheld.

label: Well-being spend (% of revenue)
definition_plain: What the company spends on employee well-being measures, as a share of its revenue.

label: Sourcing from MSMEs (%)
definition_plain: The share of input material bought directly from small businesses and small producers.

label: Days of accounts payable
definition_plain: How many days, on average, the company takes to pay its suppliers.

label: Purchases from related parties (%)
definition_plain: The share of purchases made from companies related to the owners or management.

label: Sales to related parties (%)
definition_plain: The share of sales made to companies related to the owners or management.

label: Values replaced (scale errors)
definition_plain: How many of the company-year's filed numbers were replaced by the figure from the next report because they were more than 100 times apart.
